scripts.build: pnpm --filter @kudu/shared build && pnpm --filter @kudu/frontend build && pnpm --filter @kudu/backend build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @kudu/shared build && pnpm --filter @kudu/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @kudu/backend typecheck && pnpm --filter @kudu/frontend typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @kudu/shared build && pnpm --filter @kudu/backend test && pnpm test:docker-local
scripts.test:browser-smoke: pnpm --filter @kudu/shared build && pnpm --filter @kudu/frontend build && pnpm --filter @kudu/backend exec node --import tsx --test src/data-sources.browser.test.ts
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter @kudu/shared build && pnpm --filter @kudu/backend build && pnpm --filter @kudu/backend migrate
scripts.local:import-postgres: pnpm --filter @kudu/shared build && pnpm --filter @kudu/backend exec node --import tsx src/import-postgres-local.ts
scripts.desktop:dev: pnpm build && pnpm run desktop:build:renderer && pnpm --dir desktop run dev
scripts.desktop:package:deb: pnpm run desktop:prepare:local && pnpm run desktop:build:renderer && pnpm --dir desktop run package:deb
scripts.desktop:package:appimage: pnpm run desktop:prepare:local && pnpm run desktop:build:renderer && pnpm --dir desktop run package:appimage
scripts.desktop:package:linux: pnpm run desktop:prepare:local && pnpm run desktop:build:renderer && pnpm --dir desktop run package:linux
scripts.desktop:package:win: node -e "if(process.platform!=='win32')throw Error('Package Windows SQLite on Windows, not by cross-compiling Linux native modules')" && pnpm run desktop:prepare:local && pnpm run desktop:build:renderer && pnpm --dir desktop run package:win
